id: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002)

facts.why: The pudding Dobby floats over the Masons is in the film, but the pages opened only describe a hovering pudding. Nothing read confirms cream puffs or violets on screen.
HP Lexicon lists Hagrid's treacle fudge in Chamber of Secrets chapter 7 of the book. Toffee is not named there and nothing read puts it in the film.

facts.text: Ronald Weasley, you flew a car to school! Sit down, all of you, and eat before it goes cold.
facts.why: At the Burrow Molly's real line is 'you best hope I don't put bars on your window, Ronald Weasley! Come on, Harry, time for a spot of breakfast.' She tells Arthur the boys flew the car to Surrey. The 'to school' telling off is the Howler later at Hogwarts, so the timing is off for a breakfast note.
facts.fix: Ronald Weasley, you flew that car to Surrey! Sit down, all of you, and eat before it goes cold.

facts.why: The quotes and plot read show Dobby freed with a sock hidden in the diary. Nothing opened mentions a pillowcase.
facts.fix: Dobby and the sock in the diary

vibe.verdict: A warm Burrow recipe box, but the monster, the Howler and the Lockhart circus never make the table.
